name: Roman DBDR Acquisition Corp. II
summary: Roman DBDR Acquisition Corp. II does not have significant operations. It intends to effect a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses in the cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, or financial technology industries. Roman DBDR Acquisition Corp. II was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Boca Raton, Florida.
